name: Eventful for Elementor – Events Showcase For The Events Calendar
author: ThemeAtelier

sections.description:
Elevate your event management experience with Eventful for Elementor, an innovative addon designed to work seamlessly with “The Events Calendar” plugin. Tailored for Elementor users, this plugin provides an intuitive way to showcase events with fully customizable widgets, empowering you to craft unique and visually stunning layouts.

CORE FEATURES

  • Elementor Widgets for Events: Seamlessly integrate events into your Elementor layouts with dedicated widgets, eliminating the need for shortcodes.
  • Dynamic Layout Options: Choose from List, Grid, and Carousel layouts to present your events with maximum impact.
  • Advanced Filtering Options: Highlight specific events by category, date, or custom filters, ensuring your audience finds what they need.
  • Fully Customizable Design: Control every aspect of the layout directly from the Elementor editor, from colors to typography.
  • Responsive and Modern Design: Built for all devices, your events will look stunning on any screen size.
  • Live Previews: See changes in real-time as you design event sections with the Elementor editor.
  • Flexible Date Formatting: Adjust event date formats to fit your design requirements.
  • Integration with Pro Features: Unlock additional customization and advanced tools with the Pro version.

Who Is “Eventful for Elementor” For?

Elementor Designers: Create visually engaging event displays directly from the Elementor editor, ensuring full design flexibility.

Event Managers: Showcase upcoming or past events with dynamic layouts and tailored filtering options to drive engagement and attendance.

Web Developers: Streamline your development process by integrating ready-to-use Elementor widgets for events.

Educational Institutions & Community Leaders: Organize and display community or institutional events with clarity and style.

sections.installation:
1. Upload eventful-elementor.zip to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Access the Elementor editor and drag the “Eventful” widgets into your layout to start customizing.
sections.faq:
Is this compatible with “The Events Calendar” plugin?

Yes, this addon works exclusively with “The Events Calendar” plugin.

Can I use it in combination with Eventful Shortcode?

Absolutely! Both versions are complementary, and you can use them together to enhance your event presentation.

Is this plugin free to use?

Yes, this version is free for both personal and commercial use. Pro features are available with an upgrade.

How can I get support?

Submit your query in the plugin Support Forum.

Can I suggest new features?

We welcome suggestions! Share your ideas in the Support Forum or email us at themeatelierbd@gmail.com.

  • Added: Option to turn on/off widgets.
  • Added: Help pages to get started.

1.0.0 – Nov 21, 2024

  • Initial release.
  • Added support for Elementor widgets for “The Events Calendar”.
  • Introduced List, Grid, and Carousel layouts.
  • Added filtering options and customizable design settings.
  • Ensured compatibility with WordPress 6.7 and PHP 7.0 or later.
